remarks: Welcome home! This bright and well-maintained condo offers comfortable, low-maintenance living in a prime location. Situated in a small, well-managed building with just 12 units, featuring an open living and dining area perfect for entertaining, filled with natural light and hardwood floors throughout. An updated kitchen with ample cabinetry, wine fridge, and a generously sized bedroom with walk-in closet space. Secure, designated parking is located in the garage below. Centrally located just steps from vibrant SoNo, enjoy easy access to restaurants, the harbor and marina, The SoNo Collection, The Maritime Aquarium, and more. Perfect for commuters with close proximity to the Metro-North and quick access to I-95.
